examples.question: 统计2025年1月门诊人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visit_id || id_card || treatment_occurrence_time) AS cnt FROM visit WHERE activity_type_code = '1' AND modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01' AND treatment_occurrence_time < '2025-02-01'
examples.notes: 按就诊发生日期；人次去重

examples.question: 统计2025年1月急诊人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visit_id || id_card || treatment_occurrence_time) AS cnt FROM visit WHERE activity_type_code = '2' AND modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01' AND treatment_occurrence_time < '2025-02-01'
examples.notes: 按就诊发生日期；人次去重

examples.question: 统计2025年1月医保患者人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id || v.id_card || v.treatment_occurrence_time) AS cnt FROM visit v WHERE v.activity_type_code IN ('1','2') AND v.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND v.treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01' AND v.treatment_occurrence_time < '2025-02-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medical_expense_rec m WHERE m.visit_id = v.visit_id AND m.medical_cost_pay_type_code IN ('01','02','03','09') AND m.modify_flag IN ('1','2'))

examples.question: 统计2025年1月男性患者人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id || v.id_card || v.treatment_occurrence_time) AS cnt FROM visit v JOIN patient p ON p.source_patient_id = v.source_patient_id WHERE v.activity_type_code IN ('1','2') AND p.sex_code = '1' AND v.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND p.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND v.treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01' AND v.treatment_occurrence_time < '2025-02-01'

examples.question: 统计2025年1月门急诊总收入
examples.sql: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(outpatient_cost), 0) AS total FROM medical_expense_rec WHERE modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND settle_date_time >= '2025-01-01' AND settle_date_time < '2025-02-01'

examples.question: 统计2025年1月门诊药品收入
examples.sql: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS total FROM encounter_medical_cost WHERE modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND item_type IN ('1','2','3','11') AND patient_type_code IN ('01','02') AND cost_date >= '2025-01-01' AND cost_date < '2025-02-01'
examples.notes: 药品项目类型 1/2/3/11；按费用日期

examples.question: 统计2025年1月门诊药品处方数
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM prescription_record WHERE modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND prescription_date >= '2025-01-01' AND prescription_date < '2025-02-01'

examples.question: 统计2025年1月门诊检查人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.dcid) AS cnt FROM examination_record r JOIN visit v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE r.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND v.activity_type_code IN ('1','2') AND r.execute_date >= '2025-01-01' AND r.execute_date < '2025-02-01'
examples.notes: 按检查日期；检查记录去重

examples.question: 2025年1月检查项目排名前10
examples.sql: SELECT e.examination_item_code, e.examination_item_name, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM examination_record r JOIN examination_exam e ON r.dcid = e.dcid JOIN visit v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE r.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND e.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND v.activity_type_code IN ('1','2') AND r.execute_date >= '2025-01-01' AND r.execute_date < '2025-02-01' GROUP BY e.examination_item_code, e.examination_item_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
examples.notes: 检查记录 join 检查项目；按项目计数

examples.question: 统计2025年1月住院人次
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visit_id || id_card || treatment_occurrence_time) AS cnt FROM visit WHERE activity_type_code IN ('5','6','9') AND modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND treatment_occurrence_time >= '2025-01-01' AND treatment_occurrence_time < '2025-02-01'

examples.question: 统计2025年1月住院总费用
examples.sql: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(hospitalization_total_cost), 0) AS total FROM medical_expense_rec WHERE modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND settle_date_time >= '2025-01-01' AND settle_date_time < '2025-02-01'

examples.question: 2025年1月住院费用构成
examples.sql: SELECT a.item_type_code, IFNULL(SUM(a.total_cost), 0) AS total FROM advice_cost a WHERE a.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND a.cost_date >= '2025-01-01' AND a.cost_date < '2025-02-01' GROUP BY a.item_type_code ORDER BY total DESC

examples.question: 统计2025年1月总手术例数
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.docid) AS cnt FROM operation_record r JOIN operation_operation o ON r.dcid = o.dcid WHERE r.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND o.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND o.operation_level_code IN ('1','2','3','4') AND o.operation_start_date_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.operation_start_date_time < '2025-02-01'
examples.notes: 手术级别 1-4；手术操作去重

examples.question: 2025年1月手术排名前10
examples.sql: SELECT o.operation_code, IFNULL(q.dict_label, o.operation_name) AS item_name, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM operation_record r JOIN operation_operation o ON r.dcid = o.dcid LEFT JOIN qmjk_dict q ON q.dict_code = o.operation_code WHERE r.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND o.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND o.operation_level_code IN ('1','2','3','4') AND o.operation_start_date_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.operation_start_date_time < '2025-02-01' GROUP BY o.operation_code, IFNULL(q.dict_label, o.operation_name) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
examples.notes: 按手术编码分组；字典名称可选

examples.question: 2025年1月住院诊断排名前10
examples.sql: SELECT d.diagnose_code, IFNULL(q.dict_label, d.diagnose_name) AS item_name, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM diagnose_record d JOIN visit v ON v.visit_id = d.visit_id LEFT JOIN qmjk_dict q ON q.dict_type = 'ICD-10' AND q.dict_code = d.diagnose_code WHERE d.modify_flag IN ('1','2') AND v.activity_type_code IN ('5','6','9') AND d.diag_n_osis_date >= '2025-01-01' AND d.diag_n_osis_date < '2025-02-01' GROUP BY d.diagnose_code, IFNULL(q.dict_label, d.diagnose_name) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
examples.notes: 住院诊断；字典类型 ICD-10
